items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'The guitar man' only in the context of a jam session where 'Him and they had an alto player there... So they invited us out to a place where they had a jam session'. There is no indication of a direct personal relationship, collaboration, or meeting between the interviewee

ctx.x: The guitar man. Him and they had an alto player there, he got famous too, he was in Oklahoma City. So they invited us out to a place where they had a jam session, they had trumpet players, and they had a couple of white boys there. I think Benny Goodman was in town there. And they all was there playing. And this Ann Cooper, she don't do nothing but just go there and pull out her horn and start the blowing, and see if they stay there until, if they stay there ten hours, she's there ten hours. And she was, and blow…
When you played over in England, did you play mostly for concerts or for dancing or dances, what were they? Like a night club?
